AJIO Home (Home & Kitchen vertical, ajio.com). Access tiers and navigation discovery as detailed in bs223.json (same single site visit covering all three concepts) - tier-1 HTTP with mobile curl_cffi fingerprints (chrome99_android / safari17_2_ios) for SSR pages, tier-2 Playwright WebKit+iPhone-13 emulation for the new client-rendered Fynd-CMS pages (default Chromium tier-2 attempt was Akamai-blocked).

New Arrivals-specific findings: the main mega-nav's top-level 'New Arrivals' item resolves to https://www.ajio.com/shop/fresh-arrivals (sitewide, listed as its own nav entry distinct from the Men/Women/Kids/Sale 'Shop By' group, not Home-specific), and a separate 'Collections' nav item resolves to https://www.ajio.com/capsule/newin. Both were fetched and rendered with Playwright (WebKit+iPhone-13, waited for network settle) - both are the new client-rendered Fynd-CMS storefront shell: no product-card DOM, no numberOfItems/totalResults anywhere in the rendered or raw HTML, and the embedded CMS config (window.APP_DATA) shows only editorial/campaign building blocks (same nav boilerplate present on every AJIO page) rather than a real product grid - this is a marketing/editorial landing hub per the brief's 'marketing/editorial landing page' exclusion criterion (COLLECTION-page test), not a genuine New Arrivals PLP, and in any case is sitewide/fashion-led rather than Home-scoped (its own sub-nav exposed tabs like 'Rakhi'/'Beauty', no Home tab with a working link - the embedded 'Home' tab entries all had an empty url). No dedicated Home-vertical 'New Arrivals'/'New In' nav item or sitemap node exists: the genuine backend CATEGORY sitemap (~150 nodes, full Home & Kitchen subtree) has zero node literally named New Arrivals/New In anywhere. The WEBCATEGORY (16,764 URLs) and CURATED (256,652 URLs) marketing-collection sitemaps were regex-scanned for (new-?arriv|newarriv) combined with any Home/decor keyword - zero matches; dozens of newarrivals-/newarrival-named curated collections exist but none combine with a Home/decor keyword (sampling their naming pattern, e.g. furla-newarrivals, theprepclubnewarrivals, these read as per-brand apparel drops). Sampled two Home-decor category SSR PLPs directly (/s/tablelamps-341927, /s/showpieces-341925) and the Home & Kitchen department root (/home-kitchen/c/8312, 351,128 items) - the only 'new'-adjacent signal anywhere is an arbitrary tag-facet filter ('New'/'NEW'/'NEWSEASON' tags, e.g. tags:New count=3746 spanning the ENTIRE undifferentiated department) layered onto the full category listing, not a distinct site-defined/nav-linked New Arrivals page - excluded per the same badge/arbitrary-filter reasoning as Bestsellers. Site search (/search) not used - disallowed in robots.txt (general bot-etiquette rule, respected per prior-pass precedent); the exhaustive sitemap enumeration above substitutes for it.

Conclusion: no genuine Home-vertical New Arrivals PLP exists on AJIO as a distinct, nav-or-sitemap-discoverable listing with its own exact count - the only site-level 'New Arrivals' experience is a sitewide, non-Home, editorial/marketing landing hub with no real product grid.
